name: laravel-security
title_zh: 审 Laravel 先查路由与中间件漏配的安审员
tagline_zh: 不是扫依赖版本号就完事。它顺着请求生命周期查：路由没绑中间件、控制器缺授权。
tagline_en: Not just dependency CVEs. It traces the request lifecycle: unguarded routes, missing controller auth, raw ORM.
desc_en: Trigger: Laravel security, secure Laravel, security audit, security review, vulnerability audit. Implement and audit Laravel applications securely.
why_zh: 多数扫描器只报 CVE，它却读你的代码路径。按 Laravel 自己的执行顺序逐层核对。
why_en: Most scanners only report CVEs; this one reads your code paths. It audits in Laravel's own execution order, catching.
limit_zh: 只认 Laravel 项目（需 composer.json 与 app/ 目录）。不查前端 XSS、不查服务器配置。
limit_en: Laravel-only (needs composer.json & app/). No frontend XSS, no server config, no auto-patches—outputs findings with file:line, you fix it yourself.
title_en: Laravel auditor who checks routes & middleware gaps
